title: Integral Tables and Computer Algebra Systems
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar

definitions.title: Integration Reduction Formulas
definitions.statement: Reduction formulas use integration by parts to express an integral involving a high power n in terms of an identical integral with reduced power n - 1 or n - 2.
definitions.explanation: Serves as the recursive basis for CAS algorithms and tabulated integral handbooks.
definitions.keyTakeaway: Reduction formulas step down powers recursively to elementary base cases.
